summary: Iteration 16: End-to-end testing of the new Comunicacion (Announcements) module. Backend pytest: 12/12 PASS covering list/CRUD/active flows + plan-based filtering for Enterprise and Free admins. Frontend Playwright: SuperAdmin /admin/comunicacion page loads, stats cards (3 total, 3 activos, 0 inactivos), 3 seeded rows render with correct type badges (Informativo=blue, Promocion=green, Alerta=amber) and segment badges (Free, Basic+Enterprise, Todos). Create -> Edit -> Toggle -> Delete dialog flow works end-to-end via UI with toasts. Admin dashboards verified: Enterprise admin (analuhs@gmail.com) sees 2 banners (promo green + warning amber); Free admin (admin@cortexia.gt) sees 2 banners (info blue + warning amber). X dismiss button removes banner from view (2->1). Sidebar shows 'Comunicacion' with megaphone icon for SuperAdmin only.

minor.issue: Target city filtering uses substring match on company.address (lowercased) - functional but may cause false-positive matches if a city name is a substring of any address field (e.g., 'Guate' would match 'Guatemala'). Currently no real failures observed.
Date filtering relies on YYYY-MM-DD string lexicographic comparison ($lte/$gte) - works because dates are stored as strings, but coupling is fragile if date storage changes to datetime objects.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/announcements.py L81-89: company.plan_id is used directly as the _id in db.plans.find_one. If plan_id is ever stored as a string instead of ObjectId, the lookup silently returns None and ALL plan-targeted announcements get filtered out (admins see nothing). Consider being defensive: if isinstance(company['plan_id'], str): ObjectId(company['plan_id']).

/app/backend/routes/announcements.py L99-101: target_cities filter uses substring containment against company.address (lowercased). 'Guate' would match 'Guatemala', and 'a' matches almost anything. Prefer exact match against a dedicated company.city field or word-boundary match.

/app/backend/routes/announcements.py L51-53: AnnouncementUpdate model_dump(exclude_unset=True) is correct, but there is no validation that 'type' is one of (info/warning/promo) on update. A malicious/buggy PUT could store an arbitrary type string and the UI would silently default to 'info' styling.

/app/backend/routes/announcements.py L60: DELETE returns 200 even if the ObjectId is malformed or the document does not exist - no 400/404 distinction. Wrap with try/except like update_announcement does for consistency.

/app/frontend/src/pages/AnnouncementsPage.js: dismissedAnnouncements is component state only - dismissals reset on full page refresh. The PRD says 'por sesion' so this matches the spec, but if persistence per browser session is desired use sessionStorage.
/app/frontend/src/pages/AnnouncementsPage.js L52: setPlans(planRes.data) assumes /api/plans returns an array. If response shape changes the map at L144 will crash without an error boundary.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 3 seeded announcements. Test created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed announcements within each test run.
